facts.description: Saved structure metadata and revision. Position tolerance is room-local metres, rotation tolerance is degrees, scale tolerance is an absolute uniform-scale difference. Each slot keeps an exact object ID even after deletion. Use structure.slot by index for its saved room-local pose. Changes to a member's live pose do not change this definition revision. Definitions do not contain geometry, replacements or scan anchors.

facts.label: Structure slot baseline
facts.description: One saved slot by zero-based index. target remains the exact member ID when that object is missing. Position/rotation/scale are the baseline in room-local axes, not the live transform. Read object.placement for a present member's current pose. This read does not authorize editing the returned target.

facts.label: Live structure state
facts.description: Compare every live member's room-local origin, rotation and uniform scale with the saved baseline tolerances. displaced counts present pieces outside any tolerance; missing counts deleted members; held counts direct grips. available=false when runtime is paused or any present transform is unavailable/invalid; do not interpret partial counts as a complete outcome then. A grip may intentionally displace a piece. This is a sampled pose comparison, not proof of stability, contact cause, visible deformation or collapse. Programs choose thresholds and settling delays; use contact observations separately when explaining likely causes.

facts.label: Starter object template
facts.description: One bundled editable template, by zero-based index. Read 0 then advance until total; later indexes are unavailable. Use the exact hash with object.create kind template. generatedVertices counts custom lathe/extrusion/sweep vertices, not built-in primitive meshes; parts and collisionPieces are separate costs, not a Quest performance guarantee. Reading neither creates an object nor starts physics. Definitions are bundled offline; created objects expose their full editable source through the object recipe/collision/settings facts.

facts.label: Preview aimed throw
facts.description: Read a fresh bounded estimate using the exact same arguments and collision checks as Aim and throw object. ready=false gives a reason; numerical fields are zero placeholders when not ready. This never launches, reserves or authorizes motion. Point inputs and result origin/destination use authored room coordinates. Velocity is physical metres/second along room axes; speed and radius use physical units. Ready estimates are instantaneous snapshots, with no guarantee of arrival or a moving target remaining in place.

facts.label: Live physical catch attempts
facts.description: Read active attempts for a loaded prop. Waiting does not own the prop, holding means actual contact capture, and missed means timeout. Retired attempts leave this list; their durable one-off receipt remains authoritative. No inference from avatar proximity.

facts.label: Current physical pencil
facts.description: Session-local mode and next-stroke ink, shared with the physical tray. Reads do not capture geometry, change colour or enable input.

facts.label: Object drawing tip
facts.description: Saved tip configuration and current object revision. configured=false returns inert default fields for editing; it does not add a component. Reads do not draw. Use object.drawing.capture for the shared active/retained capture.

facts.label: Liquid container and contents
facts.description: Saved cavity, capacity, exact contents and current object revision. configured=false returns editable defaults, without creating a component. Both rectangle dimensions are zero for a cylinder; positive dimensions replace radius for a rectangular cavity. terrainFloor=true binds the cavity to the same object’s canonical height surface; frame/rectangle/capacity are derived and ground edits preserve amount or refuse overflow. Amount/capacity use local millilitres, independent of prop scale. Reads do not refill, transfer or simulate liquid.

facts.label: Measured carried material
facts.description: Saved logical local litres, capacity, material identity and colour. Quantity stays unchanged on resize and does not set mass or infer geometry. Missing stores return inert editable defaults with configured=false. Reading never creates material or starts simulation.

facts.label: Sculptable surface
facts.description: Saved field geometry, local geometric volume, height range and current object revision. Missing fields return inert editable defaults with configured=false/count=0. Exact heights are paged through object.field.samples. Volume is in unscaled local litres; prop scale does not rewrite heights. Read-only; no reset or simulation.

facts.label: Exact surface heights
facts.description: Read at most 16 saved grid-vertex heights in row-major order, X first then Z, in local metres along frame +Y. Matching revision required. Offset equal to count returns an empty page; later offsets, missing fields or stale revisions are unavailable. Read all pages to reconstruct the exact source; this never sculpts or advances a revision.

facts.label: Object sculpt tip
facts.description: Saved sculpt-tip configuration and current object revision. Missing tips return inert editable defaults, configured=false. Shape modes have amountLitres=0; scoop has height=0. Reads never begin a gesture or modify geometry. Use object.field.capture for live/retained gestures.

facts.label: Current physical sculpt tool
facts.description: Session-local trigger/fingertip sculpt settings shared with the tray. Reads do not enable input or modify a surface.

facts.label: Current physical material packing tool
facts.description: Session-local touch-and-lift/trigger packing settings. Enabling does not create a ball or start physics. Reads do not enable input.

facts.label: Physical material packing draft
facts.description: Frozen preview amount and room-local ball position and exact capture session. Use object.field.capture.path for its single local footprint and object.field.resolve for explicit Retry/Discard. lastSaved records the most recent successful physical packing in this live room, not current existence: Undo/deletion may remove that ball. Explicit object.material.pack calls do not set this physical observation. Reads have no effect.

facts.label: Physical sculpt draft
facts.description: Current shared shape or material gesture, field target, brush settings, sampled point count and bounded error. Material take/deposit/pack has one point and zero height; inspect object.material.capture or material.pack.capture for quantities and the last packed ball identity. Before acceptance the preview is visible only. Saving includes queueing/preparation and native acceptance followed by durable publication; collision updates at acceptance. Unsaved needs explicit Retry/Discard. An accepted failure is no longer a retryable draft; inspect its status and room state. Read object.field.capture.path for exact points. Reads do not change the draft.

facts.label: Exact sculpt gesture path
facts.description: Read eight local X/Z points of the active or retained sculpt draft. Exact sessionId required; offset=count is an empty page and later offsets are unavailable. A live path can grow; freeze it by finishing the gesture before reconstructing a retained failed draft. No sampled path can exceed 32 points.

facts.label: Physical material draft
facts.description: Current contact or retained measured scoop/deposit, exact session and both saved/preview carrier amounts. Field geometry and carried heap preview one bounded transfer. The saving phase covers queueing, preparation and confirmation. Native acceptance applies both balances together; completion confirms their background save. Before acceptance interruption retains both drafts; after acceptance the edit cannot be retried. Use object.field.resolve with this sessionId to retry/discard an interrupted draft; read object.field.capture.path for its one local centre. Reads do not begin, retry or repeat a gesture. Local litres do not imply world-space volume or rigid mass.

facts.label: Live container contents
facts.description: Current native liquid quantity during physical pouring or scooping, separate from the last accepted object.container definition. Flowing contents are published together after 0.3 seconds without flow, at grip release, pause or Save, at bounded ten-second checkpoints, and before an empty participating vessel adopts a different liquid identity or colour; one Undo restores that episode. Acceptance updates live contents immediately; persistence runs in order off the interaction thread with at most two queued checkpoints. Full storage admission pauses additional intake, never accrues skipped time, and does not freeze vessel movement. A failed save keeps accepted quantities as unconfirmed and blocks further saves until explicit workspace recovery. Read world.liquidPersistence for durability; savedAmountMl is the last journal-accepted amount, not proof of disk persistence. transferredMl/spilledMl are outgoing pouring totals for this source in the current episode, reset at journal acceptance. Scooping has separate object.container.scooping counters. No per-drop rigidbodies, carried fluid mass or mixing. Terrain reservoirs share the same measured inventory, level and publication. Shared bounded buoyancy/drag is described by object.medium. Amounts use logical millilitres independent of visual resizing. Waiting means complete transfer-work capacity or this container interaction group's required spatial inputs are unavailable; error explains it. Before changing quantities, each complete interacting group prepares relevant saved solids, ground and receiving/donor cavities, including empty or offset cavities and rain cover. Quantity paths close transitively, including retained or anchored dormant poses and connected moving bodies; sharing a read-only obstacle or roof alone does not join separate groups. Ready independent groups can advance while another waits or loads. Each complete quantity group receives its own execution allowance, atomically coupled with its moving-body dependencies. Independent groups do not pay for unrelated dormant inventory. Preparation includes streams that a currently empty tilted receiver could produce after earlier intake in that same pass, and rain cover for cavities that could drain before collection. Missing geometry is never treated as an empty path. Regrouping already-ready inputs preserves the live episode. If a group that owns unfinished quantities needs unavailable inputs, the existing shared episode publishes before preparation and releases its writer before callbacks. Continued waiting does not repeatedly checkpoint independent flow. All groups still share atomic journal acceptance; skipped time is not accrued. Passive facts never load geometry or restart physics. Inspect runtime.flowWorkBudget and runtime.flowWorkReservation.

facts.label: Liquid save status
facts.description: Shared durability of accepted automatic pour, scoop and rain checkpoints. At most two immutable snapshots wait in order. saving is not a durable receipt. unconfirmed preserves accepted live quantities and original saved files, blocks further saves, and requires explicit workspace recovery; do not replay the transfer. Successful notifications wait for an episode boundary and are not replayed after reload. Temporary forks accept locally without saving the ordinary room. idle means no pending automatic checkpoint, not that unrelated edits are saved.

facts.label: Live liquid scooping
facts.description: Current physical-flow episode: scoopedMl entered this vessel through its submerged opening; drawnMl was taken from it by other vessels. donors/recipients count distinct counterpart vessels. These counters reset at journal acceptance or cancellation of an unaccepted episode. Read world.liquidPersistence for asynchronous save status; failed saves preserve accepted quantities as unconfirmed. An empty participating vessel changing liquid identity or colour first closes its prior episode. Read object.container.live for current and accepted quantities. An upward-facing smaller open cavity must fit inside the donor with its entire opening below the measured surface, with a clear bounded path. The same conserved quantities, physics pause, grips, save/Undo and temporary-room episode are used for pouring and scooping. Shared bounded buoyancy/drag is described by object.medium. No level displacement, air simulation or terrain pools. Waiting means shared pour/scoop/rain work capacity or this complete interacting group's spatial inputs are unavailable; object.container.live.error gives the reason. Independent ready groups can continue, while all groups retain the same shared atomic acceptance and ordered saving. Waiting does not accumulate intake.

facts.label: Object or Maestro water contact
facts.description: Complete contact passes take independent fair turns on the shared simulation clock, at most one automatic pass per opportunity. Contacts sample at up to 20 Hz: rigid props use the shared 4x4x4 occupancy grid; Maestro uses six visible mapped joints (feet, hands, hips and head); each hand uses its tracked index fingertip, each controller its aim-pose origin. This is bounded sampled contact, not whole-skin or fluid simulation. known=false means unavailable, never dry. Samples expire after 0.2 seconds; tracking expires after 0.15 seconds, using real elapsed time even within a slow frame. A missed sampling opportunity, expired samples and tracking source changes establish a fresh baseline before testing movement; missed intervals never create crossing, entry, exit, speed or ripple effects. Physics, participant and vessel environment policies, geometry, lifecycle and workspace holds apply. Spawn, reload, geometry/ownership changes and tracking reacquisition establish a baseline without entry/exit events. Nested water chooses the smallest containing cavity then stable ID. Contacts change no quantities or velocities. Transient ripples use at most eight one-second waves per vessel on its clipped surface. Read the last sampled aggregate for a created prop or Maestro. surface is an authored-coordinate projection, depth is physical metres. When dry, surface is only the first sampled position.

facts.label: Tracked hand or controller water contact
facts.description: Complete contact passes take independent fair turns on the shared simulation clock, at most one automatic pass per opportunity. Contacts sample at up to 20 Hz: rigid props use the shared 4x4x4 occupancy grid; Maestro uses six visible mapped joints (feet, hands, hips and head); each hand uses its tracked index fingertip, each controller its aim-pose origin. This is bounded sampled contact, not whole-skin or fluid simulation. known=false means unavailable, never dry. Samples expire after 0.2 seconds; tracking expires after 0.15 seconds, using real elapsed time even within a slow frame. A missed sampling opportunity, expired samples and tracking source changes establish a fresh baseline before testing movement; missed intervals never create crossing, entry, exit, speed or ripple effects. Physics, participant and vessel environment policies, geometry, lifecycle and workspace holds apply. Spawn, reload, geometry/ownership changes and tracking reacquisition establish a baseline without entry/exit events. Nested water chooses the smallest containing cavity then stable ID. Contacts change no quantities or velocities. Transient ripples use at most eight one-second waves per vessel on its clipped surface. Pointing a ray at distant water does not touch it. Tracked physical inputs use the global real-room policy.

facts.label: Liquid medium at a point
facts.description: Read finite live liquid at an authored world-coordinate point. Cylindrical/rectangular container geometry and the shared free surface use current pouring/rain quantities, not a second water store. target optionally selects the actor whose real-room readiness applies; empty uses global policy. found is geometric containment; active additionally requires unpaused admitted physics for both actor and medium. Nested or overlapping cavities select the smallest physical cavity, then stable object ID, never added densities. surface is projected along gravity and depth is in physical metres. Logical ml/capacity determine fill fraction; visual scale changes geometric displacement without creating contents. No terrain reservoir, fluid level displacement, route clearance, swimming or automatic mixing is implied. Incomplete cavity availability forces found=false and active=false; another resident medium cannot substitute for it. availability is ready when potentially relevant liquid cavities have native placements and current contents. A dormant, inactive or missing vessel is pending while activation is queued/running, otherwise unavailable. Unknown cavity bounds remain dependencies; known distant cavities and accepted empty vessels are excluded. dependencyCount counts all missing relevant cavities; dependencies lists the first four stable IDs, not necessarily the whole set. This passive query never loads or retries an object. Native collider readiness, physics, ownership and each participant's real-room policy are separate requirements.

facts.label: Rigid prop medium response
facts.description: Last native physics sample for a created prop. A cached 4x4x4 occupancy grid approximates the union of accepted box/sphere/capsule/convex-mesh colliders; thin geometry can have no supported samples. Existing mass and explicitly configured fluid density determine buoyancy, with linear/angular drag. Lift and linear drag acceleration are capped at 30 m/s2. Forces never alter saved poses/quantities or bypass fixed, held, animation-owned, paused or unavailable physics. A prop excludes its own liquid. applied is rechecked against current ownership/readiness; submergedFraction and displacementM3 describe the last sample. No carried-liquid mass or fluid-level displacement. Actor locomotion requires a separate traversal policy and is not proven by this fact.

facts.label: Saved snap point
facts.description: One root-local alignment frame and its current object revision. Missing points return configured=false with inert defaults so a new point can be configured. Read object.placement separately for its object's live room-local pose. There is no snap occupancy state; ordinary placement or physics can move pieces afterwards.

facts.label: Object snap points
facts.description: Read stable point IDs eight at a time, with total and current revision. Start offset 0 and advance by eight; an offset past the end returns an empty page. Read each definition with object.snapPoint. Reading does not reserve a slot or move anything.

facts.label: Saved physical connection
facts.description: Shared settings and current object revision. configured=false returns inert defaults. connected is the exact ID or empty. Read frames with object.connection.frame and type-specific settings with object.connection.hinge or object.connection.slider. Broken play state is read separately.

facts.label: Rotating hinge settings
facts.description: Limits and drive settings for a configured rotating hinge; unavailable for fixed or absent connections. Read this and the local frames at the same object revision before configuring.

facts.label: Sliding connection settings
facts.description: Limits span at least 0.005 connected-object local metres. Positive travel/speed follows the connected frame +X. Spring target must be inside its limits. Read frames at this same revision before editing. Unavailable for other connection kinds.

facts.label: Live sliding distance
facts.description: Signed anchor distance along the connected frame +X, in connected-object local metres. Unavailable unless the slider and exact other object are loaded. Read object.connection.state to distinguish active, paused or broken; a distance alone does not prove a press or contact cause. Use ordinary condition waits with separate press/release thresholds for hysteresis.

facts.label: Saved connection frame
facts.description: One local frame within the program-value budget. Use the same object revision for both sides; reading never aligns or starts physics.

facts.label: Live physical connection
facts.description: active means an admitted native constraint. broken is latched until an explicit accepted configure/attach/align/slide, successful runtime rearm or workspace recreation. angle is signed degrees about the saved +X axis, not a revolution count or fixed-joint freedom. This reading does not authorize edits or identify the cause of a break.

facts.label: Object passthrough openings
facts.description: All saved windows (at most four) and the current object revision. requested means a visible opening is requested; renderingReady means the local passthrough subsystem is running, not proof of pixels, real alignment or headset acceptance. physicalAnchor identifies exact scanned attachment; observe object.scanDrawing for its availability. Read object.surface for the referenced plane's pose and dimensions. Layer opacity multiplies reveal independently of material opacity. Reads do not request camera sharing, scanning or permission.

facts.label: Object lamps
facts.description: Saved lamp IDs and current native emission state. Read object.light with a lamp ID for its exact source and effective controls. Reads are passive. Active does not establish visible illumination, shadows, real-room lighting or headset performance.

facts.label: Object lamp details
facts.description: Saved component, effective controls, exact runtime stateId and native emission status. Unavailable for missing lamps. Read-only: does not refresh, allocate, start a light or change a revision. A renderer can be inactive while its controls are retained. Does not establish rendered pixels or headset performance.

facts.label: Imported model geometry
facts.description: Saved model settings and actual load/preparation readiness. sourceSize is in source units; size is local metres before the owning object's scale. ready does not certify a walking route or headset performance. Null for non-model objects. Read the current revision before editing.

facts.label: Object drawing surfaces
facts.description: All configured drawing patches (at most four), with the current object revision. Reads do not infer surfaces from a mesh or collider. part is empty for object-local coordinates. Mark counts remain when drawing is disabled. Read object.surface and object.surface.strokes for exact editable definitions.

facts.label: Drawing surface definition
facts.description: Exact plane/cylinder/sphere configuration in its object's or recipe part's local axes. The tangent origin faces -Z; shape and curvatureRadius define the same editable surface mapping. This is saved configuration, not the current animated world pose; a patch does not follow skin deformation or imported bones.

facts.label: Surface stroke identities
facts.description: Read up to six saved stroke identities in creation order. Exact current object revision is required; offset equal to total returns an empty page. Read object.surface.stroke for colour and points; IDs survive object copying within their own surface.

facts.label: Surface stroke point page
facts.description: Read colour, radius and up to six exact surface-coordinate points. Points use patch-local arc metres (equatorial X on spheres); radius uses geometric local metres; z=0, X/Y remain inside the patch including radius. Paged reads refuse stale object revisions. No projection, simplification or ownership is implied.

facts.label: Saved pencil stroke
facts.description: Current saved stroke revision, count and object-local radius; reads the temporary fork when active. Does not sample the live pencil or alter geometry. Missing/non-drawing targets are unavailable. Use the exact revision for edits and paged point reads. Scanned ink layers use object.surfaces instead.

facts.label: Saved stroke point page
facts.description: Read at most eight exact object-local points at offset, with the current saved revision. Total is the complete stroke count. Offset equal to total returns an empty page; a later offset, stale revision or missing/non-drawing target is unavailable. Scanned ink layers use object.surfaces instead. No simplification, coordinate conversion or ownership is implied.

facts.label: Physical pencil draft
facts.description: Live pencil phase (idle, drawing, unsaved), point count, mode (none/draw/erase), selected erasure stroke count, temporary-room flag and bounded error. Unsaved retains a frozen failed stroke in memory and requires explicit Retry or Discard with this exact identity. Reads do not capture geometry or save it. Completed receipts and a later draft have different identities.

facts.label: Editable recipe summary
facts.description: Saved recipe counts, timing, loop and autoplay preference plus actual playback. Reads the temporary fork when active. Exact revision guards edits and paged part/track reads; missing/non-recipe targets are unavailable.

facts.label: Recipe part
facts.description: Read one exact saved part by index and revision. Root parent is empty text. Coordinates/dimensions are local metres; rotation is a unit quaternion. All 32 base part records remain readable without simplification. For lathe, extrusion or sweep geometry also read object.recipe.profile; sweeps additionally use object.recipe.path, all at the same revision. The pattern record includes the exact saved kind, plane, column/row counts and alternate pigment hex colour; absent patterns read as solid UV with 1x1 cells and white alternate pigment. This base record omits profile, segments and path. Missing targets, stale revisions and later indexes are unavailable.

facts.label: Recipe track key page
facts.description: Read up to four exact saved rotation keys for the indexed track and revision. count is this track's full key count, offset is the first returned key. Offset equal to count returns an empty page; later offsets/indexes, stale revisions and missing recipes are unavailable. Read all 17 tracks and 16 keys without simplification. No playback or editing occurs.

facts.label: Recipe profile points
facts.description: Read up to four exact profile points for an existing lathe, extrude or sweep part at a fixed object revision. For lathe, x is radius, y is height and segments is the angular subdivision count. For extrude, x/y are the normalized XY outline and segments is zero; thickness is part.size.z. For sweep, the XY section follows object.recipe.path and segments is zero. vertices is a conservative generated vertex cost for the whole recipe; the room limit is 262144. Offset equal to count returns an empty page. Missing/non-profile parts, stale revisions and later offsets are unavailable. The profile is geometry, not a fluid container or a hollow collider.

facts.label: Recipe sweep path
facts.description: Read up to four exact normalized XYZ path points at a fixed object revision. Read object.recipe.profile for the closed cross-section. Dimensions and placement come from object.recipe.part. Offset equal to count returns an empty page; stale, missing, non-sweep and later offsets are unavailable. This reads saved geometry and does not move an object.

facts.label: Collision shape summary
facts.description: Exact saved/temporary collision recipe counts and revision. pieces is the reserved compound-piece budget, even while an explicit box/sphere override bypasses the recipe. customActive means automatic mode selects the recipe; this does not imply running physics or loaded imported geometry. Missing/built-in targets are unavailable.

facts.label: Collision shape source
facts.description: One exact root-local proxy at a fixed revision and index. All saved shapes remain readable; stale revisions, missing targets and indexes at/after count are unavailable. Read object.collision first.

facts.label: Live recipe part pose
facts.description: Read one named part's current local/room position and unit rotation, exact saved object revision, parent and whether that track is playing. Local coordinates are relative to its parent; room coordinates use the authored room frame, independent of virtual-world translation or yaw. Parent motion carries descendants. Reads neither start playback nor grant edit authority. Missing, inactive or non-recipe parts are unavailable; parts without tracks are still readable. This is a live observation, never a saved key or independent physical body.

facts.label: Live attachment point
facts.description: Read the exact selected anchor in authored room coordinates using the same admission checks as object.hold. Part is a recipe ID, left/right hand, or empty for a root. Offset units scale with the holder root; returned scale is that root's uniform scale relative to the authored room. Room translation/yaw does not change the returned pose; this is a snapshot, not a persistent real-surface anchor. Matching revision/hash is required; held/missing/replaced anchors fail. This does not reserve an object, fit a prop, start motion or grant mutation authority.

facts.label: Current prop attachment
facts.description: Observe the current shared hold component for one loaded creation: holding, released, failed or idle. It covers animation-fitted avatar props and object.hold. Released means physical handoff actually occurred, not just a planned throw. Once the component retires, idle does not erase its historical receipt; inspect that receipt for the completed/interrupted outcome. No automatic recovery or replay.

facts.label: Object room position
facts.description: Current transform origin in authored room coordinates as a record {x,y,z}, matching object.position.set and layout inputs. This is not a mesh centre, surface, floor height or navigation destination. Target may be the book, Maestro or an existing creation. Grabs, animations and physics all affect the reading; physics need not run. Missing/disabled targets, invalid positions and paused app runtime are unavailable. Reads take no ownership, grant no editing authority and do not subscribe. Save the result in a local when several calculations need the same snapshot. Virtual-world translation or yaw does not change this snapshot. It identifies a place in this authored room, not a persistent anchor to a physical surface or a point in another room. Invalid room frames are unavailable.

facts.label: Object physics settings
facts.description: Accepted saved or temporary physics settings and exact target revision. These preferences do not prove a running simulation, ready geometry or current speed. Read physics.running separately. Only user-created objects have editable physics.

facts.label: Water traversal settings
facts.description: Accepted actor policy and exact revision. default resolves to avoid for Maestro and ignore for creations. The saved wading/avoid-egress depth is additionally limited by actual body height. This read does not move, swim or alter physics.

facts.label: Water path inspection
facts.description: Read-only continuous liquid check from the target's current upright walking envelope to an authored-room position. It samples current fill levels and per-actor environment admission. An avoid policy permits only an already-wet shallow exit toward a nearest edge or shallower ground, never deeper; allowed does not mean the actor has reached dry ground. allowed proves only water policy, not terrain, obstacle clearance, ownership or a connected route. bodyId is the refusing vessel, or the deepest allowed vessel. Unavailable/pending cavities refuse traversal without inventing a blocking-water contact or detour. An explicit ignore policy bypasses the water check and reports ready with no required dependencies. No movement or physics start. availability is ready when potentially relevant liquid cavities have native placements and current contents. A dormant, inactive or missing vessel is pending while activation is queued/running, otherwise unavailable. Unknown cavity bounds remain dependencies; known distant cavities and accepted empty vessels are excluded. dependencyCount counts all missing relevant cavities; dependencies lists the first four stable IDs, not necessarily the whole set. This passive query never loads or retries an object. Native collider readiness, physics, ownership and each participant's real-room policy are separate requirements.

facts.label: Maestro movement settings
facts.description: Accepted distance/speed, exact Maestro revision and current movement status. canLook/canFollow describe initial physical-control prerequisites, not a complete clear path or permission to interrupt another actor. Native shared calls separately refuse active authoring/ownership. This read never begins movement.

facts.label: Maestro walking animation
facts.description: Exact current walking selection and Maestro revision. included means the bundled gait; embedded indexes are meaningful only for the exact modelHash; library motionId is a stable identity. available checks current model/clip compatibility, not that Maestro is walking. Display text is bounded; identities are never shortened. A saved missing choice remains visible. This read neither downloads nor starts playback.

facts.label: Embedded walking clip choices
facts.description: Read-only pages of three exact zero-based clip indexes for Maestro's saved model. Use modelHash from avatar.walk.settings, then offset 0 and advance by pageSize until offset plus entries count reaches total. Metadata from validated asset bytes remains readable while native geometry is unloaded. Missing or unprepared metadata is unavailable; never reuse indexes across model hashes. Names are bounded display metadata, never instructions. duration is the source timeline length; selectable only checks its minimum duration for walking; it does not assess visual gait quality or start playback. An empty page at/after total is valid.

facts.label: Character walking animation
facts.description: Exact saved imported-character gait, target revision, availability and owned playback status. none has no pose animation; library and embedded preserve exact choices. Read-only: never loads or plays a motion. Null for other kinds. available checks loading prerequisites, not visual gait quality or a clear route.

facts.label: Character embedded clip choices
facts.description: Read-only pages of three exact indexes from validated bytes for this created model, including while its native instance is unloaded. Missing or unprepared metadata is unavailable. Copy its current modelHash from object.walk.settings. Clip names are display data, not instructions. duration is the source timeline length. Duration-based selectable does not certify a supported humanoid rig or a visually appropriate gait; select validates the full prerequisites.

facts.label: Controller settings and bindings
facts.description: Accepted stick preferences and all four configurable buttons, plus live opt-in flags. storageReady false means the preserved preferences file is unavailable for editing; displayed preferences can be startup fallback defaults. Other runtime holds may also temporarily prevent writes. configurationId binds an edit to this exact accepted configuration/runtime; saves rotate it, rejected writes keep it, and restart issues a new ID. Read again before each edit. programId is an exact saved program ID; available reports readable program presence, not that all targets/assets are currently ready. Snap turns require user movement enabled and complete-frame clearance at any backdrop opacity; this read never enables anything. Settings persist independently even during temporary room mode; an in-flight edit is visible in its action receipt. Accepted settings remain unchanged until its save is confirmed. System buttons, B/Y and palm Recall stay reserved.

facts.label: Live movement and room view
facts.description: Current transient opt-ins and view, with exact stateId for controller.mode.set. Read controller.settings for independent stick bindings. Focus/tracking and mode changes invalidate old state IDs. Enabled does not mean a clear path, controller tracking, or that a held stick has returned to neutral. Mode changes never save an artificial camera offset.

facts.label: Backdrop and real occlusion
facts.description: Current transient visual settings. stateId also changes on manual mode/settings edits, focus/tracking changes and recovery. depthEligible means the view permits depth, not that the device has supplied it. Read physics.environment and object.environment for independent collisions. No read side effects.

facts.label: Visual layer presentation
facts.description: Transient viewer preferences for one saved layer. opacity is the requested multiplier, progress.currentOpacity is its interpolated value and effectiveOpacity includes the authored default. effectiveRealDepth is only layer eligibility, not proof of device depth. stateId changes on new preferences, resets and saved definition changes, never each blend frame; viewStateId guards tracking/control recovery. Unavailable if the layer or configured view is missing. Reads do not advance a fade or mutate saved contents.

facts.label: Authored animation
facts.description: Saved pose/motion metadata at the current object revision, or the temporary-room fork when active. No animation is started and no live take is captured. poseSaved=false means automatic activity. Use this revision for frame/joint reads and edits; another edit or Undo invalidates it.

facts.label: Authored frame
facts.description: Read a saved frame by zero-based index at an exact object revision. Index -1 returns the saved object placement at time zero (not live physics/animation); its joint names come from the saved pose. Position/rotation are local to the room parent and scale is uniform. jointChannels distinguishes a present joint array (even empty) from null. Read individual rotations with animation.joint. Missing frames or stale revisions are unavailable.

facts.label: Canonical joint rotation
facts.description: Read one canonical local joint rotation. index -2 is the included canonical rest pose (also used for supported imported Maestro rigs), -1 is the saved pose, and 0 or higher selects a recorded frame. Missing joints/poses/frames and stale object revisions are unavailable, never synthesized identity rotations. This is not an imported model bone's raw local rotation. Reading does not enter posing mode.

facts.label: Current recording session
facts.description: Native recorder identity and phase: idle issues the next start ID; recording samples a live take; saving is a frozen session-owned background save; unsaved retains a frozen failed take in memory. Duration is sampled seconds, not wall time. Idle has empty target and zero counts/revision. Read target's authored revision before starting. Finish/discard take the current exact ID; completed receipt cancellation is separate. Error is bounded status, not a recovery token. A new app/room instance never restores an active recording.

facts.label: Pending physical keyframe edit
facts.description: One immutable physical keyframe edit, independently of selection and live posing. saving means queued/preparing/publishing; unsaved retains a failed buffer for exact retry or discard; idle has no buffer. revision is the captured target revision. writesPose indicates whether this operation changes the saved pose; poseSaved indicates a non-null captured pose. applied never means saving is confirmed. Error text is bounded. animation.edit.resolve uses this exact sessionId; idle cannot be resolved.

facts.label: Current live pose session
facts.description: Shared physical/agent pose session: idle issues the next start identity (version 0); posing identifies the current preview and supported displayed joint channels; saving identifies queued or publishing versions; editing says whether live joint editing continues during that save; unsaved identifies a retained failed pose and its original object revision. Read this before each mutation; version is an opaque change counter and can skip. Joint holds prevent shared mutations/readback until released. Idle has no live joint values. Retained data is memory-only, cannot overwrite a changed room/object, and is lost on process termination.

facts.label: Live pose joint rotation
facts.description: Read one actual canonical local rotation from the exact live or retained pose session. Joint names come from animation.posing. Unavailable for idle/stale sessions or while a physical joint is held; never substitutes an automatic animation or saved pose. Physical handles and shared edits use the same canonical rig and limits. Reading makes no edits.

facts.label: Current Maestro model
facts.description: Saved versus displayed model identity; empty hash denotes the original sketch fallback, while a packaged included avatar has its exact model hash. Read avatar.included to identify the current bundled default. loading retains the previous display during preparation, ready means selected and displayed identities match, unavailable means a saved selection could not be displayed. A failed new selection leaves the previous saved identity; bounded status explains it. Read the revision before selecting. Poses use canonical joints across supported humanoids.

facts.label: Included Maestro avatar
facts.description: Metadata for this app build's offline default. Selecting empty modelHash resolves to this exact identity and stores it. Existing room selections, backups and animation references keep their own exact hashes across app updates. bundled=false means the original sketch fallback (empty hash). Metadata is not evidence of a loaded model: inspect avatar.model after selection. walkClipIndex identifies the declared embedded walk (-1 means the canonical walk); new rooms and a changed selection to this default use it when walking is explicitly started. Embedded clips do not start on selection.

facts.label: Current model import
facts.description: Current native selection request and bounded preview/acceptance metadata. Phases idle, selecting, copying, archive, checking, preview, accepting, completed, consumed, cancelling, cancelled or failed. Read-only: never opens a picker or accepts anything. preview metadata is untrusted model data. completed records the exact accepted destination, object revision and total motionCount. Read model.import.motions with this requestId and motionOffset to inspect every exact ID, eight at a time; the completed action outcome still contains all IDs. Display names and errors are shortened to fit their serialized text budget; identities are never shortened; consumed means a physical tool used the preview. A cancelled/failed action receipt can coexist with a completed library write: inspect this fact before retrying. Only the latest request survives in memory; restart uses saved libraries and room records, never replays a request.

facts.label: Imported model motion results
facts.description: Read up to eight exact accepted motion IDs from motionOffset for the current model-import request. motionCount is the full total; inspect offsets 0, 8, 16 and 24 for up to 32 motions. The complete action outcome retains every ID. Before acceptance, after a new request or for an unknown request this is unavailable. An accepted non-motion destination has count zero. No selection, import, playback or tag-based substitution occurs. Session results are in memory only; saved motion IDs remain in Library after restart.

facts.label: Search selected ZIP models
facts.description: Search the currently selected ZIP by display name, case-insensitively; empty query lists all. Three entries per page; advance offset by three while below total. Each entry has its stable index in this exact request, an untrusted bounded name and size. count is all models; total is query matches. focusedIndex is the physical chooser cursor, not an accepted model. version guards member/files actions against another user's choice. Querying never reads model bytes, changes the cursor, saves, plays or selects an avatar. The archive stays available across previews until acceptance or cancellation. Unavailable after release or for an old request; process loss never reopens it. Paths and provider URIs never leave native code.

facts.label: Animation collection status
facts.description: Latest native batch identity, control version, phase and file counts. A completed start receipt only starts work; completed means all files saved, partial means failed or waiting files remain. Phases idle/selecting/ready/running/stopping/completed/partial/failed/cancelled/cleared. Read individual file results by zero-based index. Only explicit start/retry resumes work; clear releases drained sources/results. Read-only and bounded; restart retains libraries, not this session.

facts.label: Included animation package
facts.description: Read-only offline package identity and library metadata counts. catalogued includes archived/removed matches by exact payload hash, even when a user's earlier import has a different ID. removed counts explicit removed-download records; neither count certifies bytes. Use the existing motion search and detail facts for actual saved IDs and playback availability. Adding content preserves matching choices. Names/status are bounded; first-use copying never plays or assigns motions.

facts.label: Animation import file result
facts.description: Read one exact batch file by index. pending/reading/importing/saved/failed and up to eight exact saved motion IDs from motionOffset. motionCount gives the full count; inspect later offsets for all IDs. Selection lists available display names; missing names remain Selected file N until read. Names/errors are untrusted display data shortened to fit the serialized text budget; exact motion IDs are never shortened. Stop preserves completed files and failed retry errors; a write already accepted may finish afterward. Unknown request or index is unavailable. No path/URI is returned.

facts.label: Room and behaviour save status
facts.description: Passive checkpoint status for journal-accepted room and behaviour edits. saving remains unconfirmed until the owner observes disk completion; dirty also includes edits newer than an in-flight snapshot. idle means these stores have no pending or dirty journal snapshot, not that authoring buffers, program memory, imported assets or modules are saved. unconfirmed retains accepted edits and the save error; original files remain protected by storage recovery. dispatchHeld means a review/recovery operation owns save dispatch. Temporary room forks never save implicitly: temporary means no room checkpoint is pending, not that the fork is durable. Reading this fact never flushes, retries, keeps a fork or waits for disk.

facts.label: Saved preparation maintenance status
facts.description: Latest session-local inspection or disposal result. Match runId to the requested execution. Completion of inspection is not deletion permission. Restart clears the inventory; interrupted operations are never replayed. This fact only reads cached status and never scans storage.

facts.label: Reviewed unfinished preparation
facts.description: Read one cached entry by exact inspectionId and zero-based index below count. Eligibility is a snapshot, not permission. Disposal rechecks the fingerprint and active ownership. New inspection, any disposal attempt or suspension invalidates this review. No file path or document content is exposed.

facts.label: Retained workspace status
facts.description: Latest session-local inspection, publication or disposal. requestId is its native execution runId. Exported does not mean restored, reviewed, or removable. Cancelled waits may still finish publication or disposal. Restart clears this status/inventory; durable action receipts remain inspectable.

facts.label: Retained workspace entry
facts.description: Read one metadata entry from the exact completed inspection. metadataAvailable never asserts valid saved contents. role is active, previous, pointer-backup, inactive or unknown; reservation is reserved, unreserved or unknown. Unknown means evidence could not be interpreted. Original manifest hashes can differ from the actual saved content. None of these fields grants deletion permission; an inactive export verifies content separately.

facts.label: Permanent removal preview
facts.description: The latest completed removal preview in this session. eligible is a snapshot, not deletion permission; native removal rechecks the exact fingerprint and dependencies. Protected entries have no fingerprint or file count. Restart, a new inspection or a removal attempt clears this preview. No private paths or file contents are exposed.

facts.label: Evidence maintenance status
facts.description: Latest session-local inspection, publication or removal status. requestId is the native execution runId; match that ID and evidence identity. Exported confirms a Downloads publication, not removal permission by itself: removal checks the retained completed native execution receipt. A cancelled wait can still finish publication/removal. Failed removal may leave partial evidence; inspect again. Restart clears this status and inventory, but retained native receipts remain inspectable.

facts.label: Inspected evidence entry
facts.description: Read one bounded item from the exact completed evidence inspection. kind history identifies operation-history preservation. It never identifies a live workspace or authorizes deletion. Use this exact identity/fingerprint for export, then retain its completed export execution receipt before requesting removal.

facts.label: Workspace history repair status
facts.description: Read the latest history inspection/reset in this app session. Match requestId and target; another request replaces this status. Reset means history was preserved and tracking cleared, not that workspace content was recovered or approved. Failed/cancelled never implies reset. After restart inspect current workspace and action receipts; old operations never replay. Evidence is retained privately; no filesystem path is accepted or exposed.

facts.label: Archive selection status
facts.description: Read the exact archive or previous-workspace preview request. Previous-workspace preparation uses no file chooser. Phases: selecting, copying, preparing, prepared, activating, activated, retained, cancelling, cancelled or failed. Activated means the preview was committed; follow workspace.archive.activation to establish whether content opened. Retained means an interrupted attempt must not be reused; its files are preserved. Prepared means its manifest, documents and assets were verified into a private preview; nothing was activated. Summary counts describe that preview, including unavailable programs and missing references. Inspect errors before another choice. IDs and counts are empty/zero until a preview exists. An unknown request or paused runtime is unavailable. Read-only; never opens a chooser, imports or runs anything.

facts.label: Current workspace
facts.description: Read the live selection revision, active generation, content availability, review hold and latest tracked activation/review IDs. Empty identity means no selection could be read. This does not release review or recover anything. Use the revision with an explicitly reviewed archive activation.

facts.label: Workspace activation status
facts.description: Read the exact tracked activation. Preserving/activating precede the switch; committed means the durable selection changed. Review means imported content opened under its review hold. Read workspace.current for subsequent review completion or selection changes. Unavailable, failed, cancelled or interrupted require inspecting workspace.current; never invent success or replay the old request. Retained identity describes the previous accepted snapshot, not an instruction to discard it. Only the latest job is retained. Startup reconciles its exact committed pair and never repeats a commit.

facts.label: Workspace review status
facts.description: Read the latest exact review request. Preparing captures accepted content; prepared means its manifestHash and summary are ready to inspect, not that activity is approved. Completing rechecks and saves that content. Completed means approval was durably committed; activityHeld reports any remaining native hold. Stale means accepted content changed and needs new inspection. Failed/cancelled/interrupted/unavailable never imply approval; read workspace.current before further action. Completion is not an animation or program start. The first receipt only acknowledges this tracked operation.

facts.label: Previous workspace identity
facts.description: Read the exact retained previous-workspace metadata and the current selection revision. Available means metadata can be read, not that its assets have passed verification. Use workspace.previous.select to create and verify a separate preview, then follow workspace.archive.selection. This read never switches, resumes, clones or deletes content. Missing/corrupt metadata is unavailable; no empty or original workspace is substituted.

facts.label: Workspace recovery status
facts.description: Read the latest recovery request and verify its requestId matches your operation. Inspecting/inspected only describe metadata; preparing/prepared describe a verified copy. Preserving holds editing while workers finish; committed means selection changed, and review means recovered content opened under review. Failed, cancelled, interrupted or unavailable never imply an empty-room fallback or completed switch. EvidenceHash identifies private preserved bytes, not a download. This read never starts or retries an operation.

facts.label: Workspace recovery candidate
facts.description: Read one retained candidate by the exact inspection requestId and zero-based index below candidateCount. Availability means metadata only. Select the exact identity through workspace.recovery.select to verify documents and assets. Bad entries stay visible; original files are preserved. An outdated request or index is unavailable.

facts.label: Verified recovery preview
facts.description: Inspect the explicit source kind (fresh or retained), its source generation if retained, the new preview generation/hash and verified semantic counts for the exact recovery request. Review missing references with the user before requesting workspace.recovery.commit. These counts do not approve execution or substitute missing models/motions. Recovered activity remains held until a separate workspace review completes.

facts.label: Current calendar time
facts.description: The current device clock: exact UTC and local ISO timestamps, runtime-reported local zone, UTC offset in minutes and local weekday (sun..sat). It can change with device clock/zone settings; it is not a monotonic timer, a trusted server time or permission to start a program. Calendar timestamps are text, avoiding numeric program range/precision loss.

facts.label: Unity frame intervals
facts.description: Local Unity Update intervals ending in the last 30 seconds, at most 4096 samples. Reads are cached for up to one second. seconds sums retained intervals (the oldest can start before the window); p95 uses nearest rank. ageSeconds is the last-sample age at the cached reading. No samples means zero placeholders, not healthy timing. Pause, focus loss, disable and invalid/backwards or over-1000-second clock gaps reset the window. capacityLimited reports discarded samples still inside the window. editor distinguishes desktop test evidence. These are not GPU times, compositor/display FPS, refresh rate, memory or a Store performance verdict. No automatic settings changes or persistence.

facts.label: Imported model budgets
facts.description: Process-wide model reservations including avatars, previews, queued requests and in-flight imports, with enforced limits. Source vertices, decoded texture MiPixels (1048576 pixels), morph million-vertices (1000000) and instance counts are budgets, not measured RAM/VRAM. Does not include procedural objects, book textures, WebView or operating-system memory. Reading never loads, evicts or changes anything.

facts.label: Imported model reservation
facts.description: Read one process-wide model lease by index (0 to runtime.modelBudget.reserved.models minus one). Indices may shift between reads; reservationId is a runtime-only identity, never an authored entity reference. World/region/target identify the owning object or avatar; previews have an empty target, and unscoped desktop imports have empty world/region. role is object, avatar, preview or unscoped. queued reserves source costs before waiting for the serialized importer; loading means it has acquired that importer; ready means imported geometry exists, not that a candidate is visible or usable as collision; retiring retains costs until an abandoned in-flight importer drains. Avatar replacement can temporarily hold two leases for the same target. Disposed queued requests cancel their wait and release admission without waiting for another importer; an already running import retains its costs until it drains. The same reservationId survives queued, loading and ready. Source costs are conservative limits, not measured RAM/VRAM. Reads are detached and never load, cancel, evict or change settings. Regional streaming remains separate.

facts.label: Current room appearance image budget
facts.description: Current workspace appearance-image cache and its enforced limits. Multiple object leases share one decoded texture for an exact image hash. entries includes loading and failed bindings; owners counts leases, including a brief old/new overlap during refresh. textureBytes is a conservative RGBA-plus-mipmap estimate for ready textures, not measured RAM/VRAM or peak memory. It excludes file reads, decode scratch space, previews, imported-model textures, book/browser images and other workspaces. Reading never decodes, retries, evicts or changes anything.

facts.label: Shared appearance image reservation
facts.description: Read one current-workspace image cache entry by index (zero to runtime.imageBudget.entries minus one). Indices may shift. reservationId identifies this runtime entry until its last lease is released; reloading the same hash gets a new ID. state is loading, ready or failed. Loading/failed entries report zero textureBytes; ready reports one shared conservative texture estimate, never multiplied by owners. Ready means decoded pixels exist, not that every renderer has refreshed. Use runtime.imageOwner with the returned reservationId to inspect holders. Reads are detached and do not load, retry, evict or persist. Regional activation remains separate.

facts.label: Appearance image owner
facts.description: Read one lease of the exact runtime.imageReservation.reservationId, by index zero to its owners minus one. Indices and leaseId can change on a renderer refresh; these are runtime identities, not saved entity references. World/region/target are copied authored ownership; role is appearance, or unscoped for native fixtures with no authored owner. The owning object can be offscreen: this is resource retention, not visibility or permission to unload. A released reservation ID is unavailable and never redirects to a newer load. Texture costs are counted once by runtime.imageReservation, not per holder. This current-workspace read does not change anything.

facts.label: Shared room audio budget
facts.description: Process-wide admission for procedural and imported room-sound decoders and their voice owners, including older workspaces whose cancelled tasks are still draining. Owners share a source inside one workspace when its exact saved definition matches. Short sources reserve their complete mono 24 kHz signed-16 PCM plus four samples for rounding/tolerance. Clips over 30 seconds reserve a bounded sixteen-block cache; readyPcmBytes counts currently published resident or cached samples once per source. These are not measured or peak memory and exclude file bytes, decoder/tone scratch arrays, voice ring buffers, Unity carriers, speech/Live/browser audio and native DSP. Eight sources and eight owners are shared across workspaces. Retiring work keeps source/PCM admission until it drains, with no active voice owners. No inspection starts, stops, pauses or unloads audio.

facts.label: Room sound reservation
facts.description: Read one shared room-sound buffer by index zero to runtime.audioBudget.sources minus one. Indices may shift; reservationId identifies only this runtime allocation. World/region and exact source ID/definitionHash describe the copied source; assetHash is empty for tones. State is loading, ready, failed or retiring. ready confirms a prepared source, not audible playback or that every long-clip block is cached. Multiple owners share its bounded PCM cost and retain independent playback cursors. A stopped final owner retires the source; pending work remains admitted until its task finishes even if its workspace is gone. Use runtime.audioOwner for active instance holders. Reads are detached and never trigger decoding, eviction, replay or persistence. This is not regional streaming.

facts.label: Room sound owner
facts.description: Read one active holder of an exact runtime.audioReservation.reservationId, by index zero to its owners minus one. instanceId is the actual audio.instance identity; its phase, lifetime, progress and controls remain in audio.instance. World/region/target, emitter, role audio and source revision are copied ownership, never a saved replacement for entity references. Several voices can share one buffer and each can stop independently. Retiring entries have zero owners. A released reservation ID stays unavailable; reloading creates a new ID. Reading cannot make an offscreen sound eligible for removal or change its playback.

facts.label: Current room motion cache
facts.description: Current room library cache entries and declared curve values, including in-flight loads, with enforced limits. Excludes embedded model clips, other workspace generations, source files and actual native/GPU byte usage. Reading does not load or evict clips.

facts.label: Room sound obstruction
facts.description: Last native acoustic synchronization: active renderer, uploaded mesh/triangle counts and omitted or pending registered surfaces plus saved objects awaiting acoustic preparation (these are work counts, not unique meshes). Saved rigid geometry can be prepared without a visible instance; unsupported or failed preparation remains omitted and issue identifies the first failed saved object. Bounded direct speech obstruction uses approximate hard-surface materials, independently of collision and overlay visibility. map.geometry and map.omitted describe reflection boundaries: accepted scans, the virtual floor, and fixed unheld creations without active model/recipe/object animation. Dynamic objects still obstruct direct sound but do not rebuild reflections. Stable boundaries are mapped after two seconds, with up to four listener points, movement settling and failure backoff. While map.computing, geometry inputs are retained for the worker and active is false. map.ready confirms calculated map data, not audible reflections: the reflection mixer remains disabled. Skinned meshes, alpha-cutout imports, drawing overlays and unscanned moving real objects are not acoustic geometry; omitted does not count those unsupported categories. Counts do not verify room alignment, device audibility or performance. Reads never upload, compute, load or change the scene.

facts.label: Authored collision resources
facts.description: Process-wide retained collision geometry from authored compound shapes, accepted height fields and rigid imported-model collision. Includes disabled and prepared replacements. Source collider/triangle counts are not measured RAM, PhysX cooked size, unique mesh assets. Admission limits are reported by runtime.collisionBudget. Repeated mesh instances count separately. Default bounds, book/avatar proxies, scanned room geometry and navigation maps are excluded. Preparing costs are declared; ready costs come from actual accepted colliders; retiring costs remain until owned collider components and separately owned compound/terrain meshes are destroyed. Shared imported asset meshes have their separate model ownership. activeColliders counts enabled components in active hierarchies, not proof of simulation or contact. Reads may forget completed destruction metadata but never destroy geometry, evict, load or modify saved world data. Regional admission/streaming remains separate.

facts.label: Authored collision owner
facts.description: Read one retained authored collision lease by index (zero to runtime.collisionResources.entries minus one). Indices may shift; leaseId is an ephemeral runtime identity, never a saved object reference. World/region/target copy the owning authored entity; unscoped desktop geometry has empty identifiers. role is collision or unscoped; kind is compound, terrain or imported; phase is preparing, ready or retiring. A replacement can retain two leases for one target. Disabled geometry retains its source costs. Retiring source costs remain until owned collider components and separately owned compound/terrain meshes are gone; activeColliders reflects actual enabled components in active hierarchies. Same accounting scope and exclusions as runtime.collisionResources; not measured RAM. Use runtime.collisionBudget for enforced limits. Reads return detached metadata and never delete assets, saved objects or geometry.

facts.label: Live authored collision budget
facts.description: Process-wide enforced reservations for authored compound shapes, height fields and rigid imported collision, including private preparation, disabled geometry, replacement overlap and deferred destruction across workspaces. These logical source costs are not measured PhysX memory or frame time. Begin reserves before native collider allocation; unexpected accepted geometry exceeding that reservation rejects preparation and remains charged until rollback destroys it. Default item/book/avatar proxies, scans, navigation and other system colliders are outside this ledger. Saved quotas are independent. No read starts physics, loads or evicts objects, or alters saved data.

facts.label: Live procedural geometry budget
facts.description: Process-wide enforced admission for recipe instances, part hierarchies and generated custom-mesh source vertices. Includes private preparation, disabled instances and replaced or closed-workspace geometry until Unity destroys its roots and owned meshes. Limits are independent of saved-world capacity and leave bounded headroom for replacement. Counts are not measured RAM/VRAM or frame time; customVertices excludes shared primitive meshes, imported models, terrain, drawing, collision, material and texture costs. Reading never loads, evicts, retries or changes saved objects.

facts.label: Procedural geometry owner
facts.description: Read one runtime.proceduralBudget instance by index. Indices can shift; reservationId identifies this native allocation, not a saved object. Copied world, region and target identify its owner. Phase is preparing, ready or retiring. Ready means built geometry, not visible, audible or running behaviour; active only describes the root hierarchy. Disabled geometry and pending destruction retain their reservation. Reads are detached and cannot activate, unload or delete anything.

facts.label: Live object budget
facts.description: Process-wide native root reservations for user-created primitives, drawings, assemblies and imported-model hosts. Includes private preparation, disabled objects and deferred destruction across workspaces. The limit is independent of saved-object capacity, not measured memory or frame time. Book, Maestro, tools and other system roots are excluded; meshes, textures, lights, windows, ink, collision and simulation keep separate costs. Reading never creates, loads, retires or evicts a saved object.

facts.label: Native object owner
facts.description: Read one runtime.objectBudget reservation by index. Indices may shift; reservationId is ephemeral, not saved identity. Copied world/region/target identify the owner. Kind is the saved creation kind. Phase is preparing, ready or retiring. Ready means the native host was built, not published identity, visible geometry, imported-model readiness or running physics. Active only describes the root hierarchy. Disabled and retiring roots remain charged until destroyed. Reads are detached and cannot change saved data or load geometry.

facts.label: Shared image lifetime budget
facts.description: Process-wide authored appearance-image and local/chat import-verification reservations across workspaces. Payload reads include reserved encoded buffers and pending-preview payloads; cancelled asynchronous work stays charged until drained. Native decoding is serialized to one attempt per frame; a single decode is not a frame-time guarantee. Texture bytes conservatively estimate complete RGBA32 mip chains, including at least 2x2 decoder initialization, orientation scratch textures and deferred destruction. Decode scratch estimates metadata-copy buffers, orientation arrays and readable texture source copies; after a decode it retains readable scratch textures until destruction. These logical limits are independent of saved quotas and are not measured CPU/GPU/peak process memory: decoder internals, driver copies and garbage awaiting collection are excluded. Embedded model textures, camera/browser surfaces and system placeholders have separate ownership. Existing runtime.imageBudget remains current-workspace accounting. Reads never load, retry, evict or persist.

facts.label: Shared image reservation
facts.description: Read a process-wide image reservation by index, from zero to runtime.imageResources.payloadReads plus textureInstances minus one. Indices may shift; reservationId is runtime-only. Kind is payload or texture. Payload phases are held (reserved or inspected bytes), working (asynchronous read/decode still in flight) and retiring. Texture phases are preparing, ready and retiring; ready does not promise that a renderer has refreshed. TextureCount includes reserved allocation slots and live scratch/output textures. Retiring textures remain charged until actual destruction. World/region and role are copied from the originating request; cache target identifies its first requester, not every current owner. Use the existing workspace runtime.imageOwner facts for current material holders. Preview targets and unscoped world/region are empty; imageHash can be empty before import inspection. A read cannot mutate resources or bypass workspace file/hash validation.

facts.label: Native lamp budget
facts.description: Process-wide authored lamp and shadow-face reservations across workspaces. Includes private preparation, disabled lamps and deferred destruction. Limits are independent of saved-room quotas. Point shadows reserve six faces; spot shadows reserve one. Counts are logical admission costs, not measured GPU memory or frame time; Unity may retain internal shadow render targets after a Light is destroyed. Sun and other system lighting are excluded. Reading never creates, enables or evicts a lamp.

facts.label: Native lamp owner
facts.description: Read one runtime.lightBudget reservation by index. Indices may shift; reservationId is runtime-only. World, region, target and light identify its copied owner. Kind is point or spot. Phase is preparing, ready or retiring. Ready means ownership transferred to a native view, not that the lamp is visible or emitting. Active describes the Light component. Disabled and retiring lamps remain charged until their roots are destroyed. Reads are detached and cannot change saved data or load resources.

facts.label: Native ink budget
facts.description: Process-wide authored drawing-surface, stroke and source-vertex reservations across workspaces, including live pencil previews, private preparation, inactive hosts and deferred destruction. Each source point reserves three vertices; duplicate points may render fewer. Independent of saved-room quotas. Logical admission costs, not measured GPU memory or frame time. System artwork and selection outlines are excluded. Reading never creates or evicts ink.

facts.label: Native ink owner
facts.description: Read one runtime.inkBudget reservation by index across surfaces and strokes. Indices may shift; reservationId is runtime-only. World, region, target, role and source identify its copied owner. Phase is preparing, ready or retiring. Ready means a native host exists, including a private candidate; it does not certify publication or visibility. Active describes the host GameObject, not whether it is visible. Retiring resources remain charged until owned native allocations are destroyed. Reads are detached and cannot change saved data or load resources.

facts.label: Native window budget
facts.description: Process-wide authored window mask and shared mesh/material bundle reservations across workspaces. Includes private preparation, inactive hosts and deferred destruction. One bundle serves a native view's masks and is released when its last window is removed. Limits are independent of saved-room quotas. Logical admission costs, not measured GPU memory or frame time; internal rendering, compositor and passthrough resources are excluded. Reading never allocates a mask, enables passthrough or evicts content.

facts.label: Native window owner
facts.description: Read one runtime.windowBudget reservation by index. Indices may shift; reservationId is runtime-only. World, region and target identify its copied owner. Kind is mask or bundle; window is empty for a shared bundle. Phase is preparing, ready or retiring. Ready means native ownership transferred, including unpublished activation candidates; it does not certify publication or visibility. Active describes the host GameObject, not passthrough readiness. Resources remain charged until their owned native allocations are destroyed. Reads are detached and cannot change saved data or request passthrough.

facts.label: Native physics budget
facts.description: Process-wide authored Rigidbody/material and potential connection-joint reservations across workspaces. Counts include private preparation, inactive bodies, paused or broken enabled connections and deferred native destruction. One joint slot survives retirement and recreation without overlapping native joints. Independent of saved quotas. Logical native ownership, not measured PhysX memory or frame time. Built-in book/avatar/tools, tracked pushers, system bodies, broadphase/contact data and simulation query work are excluded. Reading never creates bodies, starts physics or evicts content.

facts.label: Native physics owner
facts.description: Read one runtime.physicsBudget reservation by index. Indices may shift; reservationId is runtime-only. World, region and target identify its copied owner. Kind is body or joint. Phase is preparing, ready or retiring. Ready means native ownership transferred, including unpublished candidates or a potential joint waiting for alignment and physics inputs; it does not certify simulation. Active describes the host GameObject. Allocated reports a still-existing Rigidbody or Joint, which may be kinematic, disabled or awaiting destruction. Body slots also retain their owned physics material until destruction. Reads are detached and cannot change saved data or start physics.

facts.label: Native liquid budget
facts.description: Process-wide authored liquid surface and potential stream owners across workspaces, including empty containers, private preparation, inactive hosts and deferred destruction. Each owner reserves one surface mesh, two materials and its two renderers before acceptance; live filling and pouring reuse them. Independent of saved container quotas. Logical ownership, not measured GPU memory, fluid solver cost or frame time. Per-tick simulation/query work, managed geometry buffers and engine internals are excluded. Reads never create water, load a view or start physics.

facts.label: Native liquid owner
facts.description: Read one runtime.liquidBudget reservation by index. Indices may shift; reservationId is runtime-only. World, region and target identify its copied owner. Phase is preparing, ready or retiring. Ready means native ownership transferred, including an unpublished or empty container; it does not certify water availability or simulation. Active describes the host GameObject. SurfaceAllocated and streamAllocated report still-existing native roots, which can be hidden or awaiting destruction. Reads are detached and cannot change saved quantities or start physics.

facts.label: Physics work budget
facts.description: Process-wide bounded requests for potential fixed-step free-body liquid-force work, including standalone bodies. Reservations include queued bodies; units count booked allowances. Complete connected bodies and their interacting liquid quantity group share one fair opportunity before gravity or fluid forces. Unrelated liquid circuits are admitted independently; an undiscovered liquid dependency remains queued without execution. A scheduled delay preserves native inputs, valid velocity/spin and live quantities. Real motion/source/ownership changes invalidate held motion. New requests cannot evict unrelated allowances within the opportunity. Oversize complete groups or a full queue are explicitly refused. Consumed charges survive request removal until the next opportunity; inspect runtime.simulationWorkLedger for committed capacity. Logical units cover bounded displacement samples, candidate media and participant environment proofs, not measured CPU time, GPU memory, frame rate or PhysX solver cost. Proof internals, pouring, scooping, rain, contact events, navigation and external observation queries are excluded. Independent of saved quotas and native allocation budgets. Reads only retire ineligible grants; they never admit work, load geometry or start physics.

facts.label: Physics work reservation
facts.description: Read one runtime.physicsWorkBudget request by index, including queued bodies. Indices may shift; reservationId is runtime-only. World, region and target identify the copied owner; empty scope denotes a standalone body. Current means its complete coupled work group has an allowance and all member demand/owners still match, not that native geometry or physics is ready. Paused, held, inactive, animated or destroyed bodies release their potential work. Reads are detached and cannot admit work or resume physics.

facts.label: Physics simulation opportunities
facts.description: Read the same opportunity clock as runtime.flowWorkSchedule. Executions count bodies with booked force allowances, including stale allowances awaiting refresh; readiness still requires the entire coupled group and its native inputs. Complete physics/liquid dependency groups take turns by oldest unserved opportunity, then stable registration order. A finite unchanged group fitting both work limits receives a turn under continuing demand. Oversize groups and a full request queue are refused. Scheduled waits preserve valid motion without accumulating force/time debt. Reading cannot advance the clock, acquire work, load geometry or restart physics.
