Logical allowances are not measured device or PhysX performance.

facts.label: Water contact work budget
facts.description: Process-wide bounded requests for complete room water-contact passes, including held/animated objects, six avatar joints and two tracked inputs. Reservations include queued passes; units count booked allowances. Fair admission occurs before displacement capture and contact queries on the shared simulation clock, independently of physics/flow execution. Scheduled waits make contacts unknown and discard crossing continuity; existing ripples finish naturally. Resuming cannot manufacture enter/exit/crossing events or old ripples. Oversize passes and a full request queue are explicit refusals. Consumed charges survive request removal until the next opportunity; inspect runtime.simulationWorkLedger for committed capacity. Logical units cover candidate/proof allowances, not measured CPU time or frame rate. Proof internals, force sampling, pouring, scooping, rain, external observations and engine costs are excluded. Independent of saved quotas and native allocation budgets. Reads may retire ineligible grants, but never admit sampling, start physics or publish events.

facts.label: Water contact work reservation
facts.description: Read one runtime.contactWorkBudget request by index, including waiting passes. Indices may shift; reservationId is runtime-only. World and region identify the copied room owner. Current means a complete sampling allowance is booked and its demand and owner still match, not that geometry, tracking or any contact is known. Demand growth cannot evict another grant or admit a room prefix. Paused, inactive or destroyed sampling hosts release work; held and animated objects remain contact participants. Reads are detached and cannot resume sampling.

facts.label: Contact sampling opportunities
facts.description: Read the same opportunity clock as runtime.physicsWorkSchedule and runtime.flowWorkSchedule. Complete contact passes take independent fair turns; booked allowances may await refreshed demand. A finite unchanged fitting pass gets a turn under continuing demand. Automatic contact sampling runs at most once per opportunity. A missed opportunity breaks crossing continuity, and stale tracking/geometry still makes observations unknown. Existing ripples may finish; missed events and accumulated time are never replayed. Reading cannot advance the clock, acquire sampling, start physics or emit contacts. Logical units are not measured device performance.

facts.label: Liquid transfer work budget
facts.description: Process-wide liquid-work host registrations. Reservations retain their host meaning, including waiting rooms; units sum booked complete quantity-group member allowances. Independent quantity groups are admitted separately with their own moving-body dependencies. Shared read-only solids or roofs do not join groups. Discovery remains independently bounded per host, and all groups retain one atomic quantity publication and Undo episode. Empty receivers and missing cavities participate in their actual dependency closure. Waiting retains valid motion and inputs without catch-up; source, placement and ownership changes require fresh preparation. Scheduled holds contribute their retained velocity/spin to flow trajectory discovery. Consumed charges survive request removal and regrouping until the next opportunity; inspect runtime.simulationWorkLedger. Inspect runtime.flowGroupSchedule, runtime.flowGroup and runtime.flowGroupMember for actual group admission. Logical units bound potential work, not CPU time, frame rate, memory or PhysX cost. Reads never admit work, load geometry, start physics or publish quantities.

facts.label: Liquid transfer work request
facts.description: Read one host registration by index. Indices may shift; reservationId is runtime-only. World/region identify the copied owner. units sums requested group demand, including conservative undiscovered placeholders. Current means at least one complete group is ready in this opportunity; it does not mean every group in the host can execute or any quantity has transferred. Inspect runtime.flowGroup for the complete-group readiness and costs. Group resizing cannot evict peers or refund consumed work. Canonical service identity survives native view retirement and regrouping. Paused, inactive or destroyed hosts release requests; explicit internal ticks can step a disabled automatic loop for desktop verification. Reads are detached and cannot resume transfers or physics.

facts.label: Liquid simulation opportunities
facts.description: Read the shared early fixed-step clock and host counts: executions counts hosts with any booked group; queued counts hosts with none. executionLimit remains 32, an upper bound on these hosts because the actual shared limit is 32 complete quantity groups; inspect runtime.flowGroupSchedule for that finer count. Booked allowances may be stale until refreshed and do not prove execution. Priority uses oldest unserved canonical member, then stable registration order, retained across regrouping and native view replacement. A finite unchanged complete group that fits receives a turn under continuing demand. Automatic work runs at most once per canonical member per opportunity, with no accumulated time debt. Reading cannot advance the clock or claim work.

facts.label: Liquid dependency discovery budget
facts.description: Process-wide booked discovery allowances on the shared simulation clock. Liquid discovery is independently admitted before its collision/cavity capture, candidate queries and native input preparation. Native inputs may load while liquid execution waits. Discovery grants are selected first on the shared clock; dependent physics and liquid execution remain queued until the discovery prerequisite is ready, then receive both execution allowances together. A preparation wait preserves service age and does not refund already booked execution within its opportunity. Demand uses canonical object and vessel counts, including dormant objects and empty containers. A changed count or world owner invalidates readiness until refreshed. One fresh collision snapshot is reused only inside the synchronous discovery pass; later passes read current placements. Units conservatively cover bounded metadata/candidate/trajectory and connection-graph visits, not measured CPU time, geometry/proof internals, allocation, sorting, native loading, PhysX or device frame time. Reservations include waiting claims and executions count booked grants, which can be stale until refreshed; neither proves native readiness or completed discovery. Passive reads cannot admit work, capture geometry, load native objects, advance the clock or change quantities. Saved/native limits are unchanged. Execution is independently admitted per complete quantity group.

facts.label: Liquid group opportunities
facts.description: Complete quantity groups, separately from the host counts in runtime.flowWorkSchedule. Groups include inactive dormant cavities; active counts requested groups. Booked means all member allowances are reserved, possibly stale; ready additionally requires current discovery, placement, native input readiness and complete physics dependencies. This permits joint preparation; physical motion and quantity transfer separately require active joints. At most 32 group allowances coexist, under the unchanged process liquid-unit limit. A conservative undiscovered placeholder never executes. Indices may shift at regrouping; inspect step, reservationId, membershipRevision and firstMember together. Reading cannot advance service, load geometry or execute quantities. These are logical allowances, not measured CPU or headset capacity.

facts.label: Liquid quantity group
facts.description: Read one complete quantity group by runtime.flowGroupSchedule index. membershipRevision changes when this host's group definitions change, including within one step; compare it on member reads and restart the read if it differs. Readiness is a momentary observation, not an atomic snapshot across queries. firstMember is a canonical object ID, not a stable group ID across merges/splits. members includes empty and missing receiving/donor cavities; shared read-only geometry does not couple independent groups. discovered=false is a conservative queue placeholder, never permission to execute. Service age belongs to canonical members and survives regrouping and native retirement; explicit canonical removal or world replacement creates new service identity. All groups share the host's atomic publication and Undo. Automatic quantity work cannot repeat a canonical member in one opportunity, even if it changes groups or its work request is recreated. No missed-time catch-up.

facts.label: Liquid group member
facts.description: Read a single member of runtime.flowGroup without exceeding the program record budget. Check step, reservationId, membershipRevision and firstMember against the group read because indices may change. units is this member's share of complete-group demand; it cannot be admitted independently of its group. order is the canonical service registration order, not array order. Passive reads do not serve the group.

facts.label: Simulation opportunity ledger
facts.description: Read one process-wide resource allowance for the current simulation opportunity. Compare step when combining separate resource reads. Committed capacity includes current grants and consumed charges retained after shrinking or removing a request. Consumed is the largest allowance already used by each request in this opportunity; retired is its subset whose requests were removed. Retired charges cannot be used again until the clock advances. Unused reservations can be released. Repeated use of one allowance does not add a new reservation and does not authorize another automatic quantity/contact tick. These are logical reservation costs, not measured operations, native residency, memory, frame time or a PhysX budget. Existing host/body schedule facts describe current requests and may be empty while this ledger still retains consumed capacity. Reads do not collect, admit, consume, load, publish or advance the clock.

facts.label: Current room session
facts.description: Current room session ID, including while using the saved room. Begin and Discard replace this identity. Read scene.temporaryRoom.active to distinguish temporary play from the saved room. Reading this ID does not begin, keep or discard a room.

facts.label: Maestro state
facts.description: Current observed tutor state: speaking, listening, thinking or idle. Unavailable before a reliable activity snapshot, during audio suspension or when the room runtime is paused.

facts.label: Room setup state
facts.description: Native room request and visibility state; readiness never verifies physical alignment. busy includes a cancelled platform worker until it drains. canLoad/canScan need an active MR room, available platform and no workspace hold. canCancel identifies an uncancelled worker, not permission to bypass lifecycle gates. A completed action receipt only acknowledges intent; inspect this fact for progress. No room geometry is included.

facts.label: Physical tool visibility
facts.description: Read the current visibility and actual grip ownership of the seven optional authoring trays. This read does not open tools or start their actions. stateId protects visibility intent, not future grip state; native execution checks holding and placement again. Visibility is transient and independent of room/program data.

facts.label: Book and tool recovery
facts.description: Read current Recall identity, book revision and admission. ready is sampled availability, not a reservation. Recall uses the current tracked view at execution; successful Recall, temporary-room boundaries and workspace replacement invalidate old IDs, and book edits invalidate old revisions. reason describes why recovery currently cannot run. No world action is performed by observation.

facts.label: Your world location
facts.description: Read the tracked authored floor position, heading and current placement guard. located=false means the position/yaw placeholders are unavailable. ready is basic workspace/tracking readiness only; requested destination clearance, ground and frame transfer are checked at execution. IDs change on world movement, temporary boundaries, observed tracking changes and successful relocation; they are workspace-local guards, not durable world or region IDs. Observation has no world effect.

facts.label: World lighting
facts.description: Saved region illumination and its current edit revision. Directions use authored world axes, independent of viewer movement. Does not report shadows, physical light or device rendering.

facts.label: World time and lighting cycle
facts.description: Current authored day/second and saved clock settings. Revision guards explicit edits; ordinary ticking does not invalidate settings. advancing reports current runtime eligibility. This is not calendar time or offline progression.

facts.label: Effective world illumination
facts.description: Sampled manual/day-cycle light energy attenuated by current cloud cover in the renderer's working colour space and authored-axis sun angles. Independent of physical passthrough, viewer state and collisions. This is mathematical readback, not measured device pixels.

facts.label: World weather
facts.description: Saved target, sampled current weather and transition on the authored world clock. Does not infer real weather or location. Read world.illumination for cloud-attenuated light energy. Rain collection uses active real time and has independent liquid-flow receipts.

facts.label: Rain exposure at a point
facts.description: Query upstream along the sampled wind/rain direction from an authored point, at most 100 physical metres. Accepted solid virtual objects and policy-enabled aligned scanned surfaces provide cover. target selects whose real-room participation applies; an empty target uses the global policy. Unknown means missing scan/alignment or saturated collision query, never an exposed surface. Rain intensity and physics pause do not change geometric exposure. Transparent solid roofs still block rain; visual opacity is independent. No unscanned physical geometry is inferred.

facts.label: Rain collected by a container
facts.description: Current shared liquid-flow episode's Water intake from precipitation. Collected quantity resets at journal acceptance or cancellation of an unaccepted episode. exposure is the open fraction of five aperture samples; unknown samples are excluded. Collection needs running physics, an available upward/wind-facing cavity and empty or matching Water contents. Rate uses projected opening area and active real time; camera visibility and authored clock speed do not multiply it. Read object.container.live for total and accepted quantities. Pouring, scooping and rain share atomic acceptance and Undo. Read world.liquidPersistence for asynchronous durability. Failed saves preserve accepted live quantities as unconfirmed and block further saving until explicit workspace recovery; do not replay intake. phase=waiting reports unavailable shared work capacity or this interacting group's spatial inputs, including saved roof and obstacle geometry along the rain paths; ready is false and exposure is zero until a fresh admitted pass. Other independent ready groups can continue; a shared read-only roof alone does not join their quantity dependencies. Cover is prepared before any quantities change, including initially full or incompatible vessels that earlier pouring/scooping could make eligible. Skipped time never accumulates rain intake.

facts.label: World and region identity
facts.description: Read the durable authored world and home/runtime region identities. Entity IDs and authored positions in this workspace are interpreted inside this scope. These identities survive reload, geometry edits, Undo, temporary keep/discard, viewpoint movement and archive restoration. They are not workspace-session guards, physical room anchors, action receipts or revisions. Authored area membership is available through world.regions and object.region. The runtime still uses one shared bounded scope; this fact does not claim regional streaming or change the 25-metre coordinate limit. Restoring an archive retains its world identity; it does not implicitly fork a new world. If identity cannot be saved or verified, this fact is unavailable. Observation never creates a world, writes a file, activates a region or starts programs.

facts.label: World area
facts.description: Saved area definition and current revision. Read every world.region.members page at this revision before renaming. This is authored membership, not a regional runtime readiness report.

facts.label: World areas
facts.description: Named authored areas ordered by stable ID, three per page. The implicit home region is available through world.identity and the empty membership choice. Advance offset by pageSize until total. Does not report loaded scene regions.

facts.label: Area creations
facts.description: Sixteen exact creation IDs per page at the area's revision. Membership is durable authored state, independent of current scene transforms.

facts.label: Area runtime dependencies
facts.description: Current native dependencies for one authored area; empty id selects home creations. Counts distinguish saved members, active native objects and objects retained by current work. Reasons include dependencies inherited through area membership and enabled physical connections, in both directions. Pending or paused audio retains its emitter. Navigation retains the authored ground sources held by its accepted or pending map; pending detours retain discovered liquid sources and canonical solid-object owners until completion or cancellation. Owned headset and scoped capture cameras retain native renderer bounds intersecting their views; stereo uses both eyes. Camera culling layers and disabled renderers are respected. The frame-sampled primary viewer adds approachingView for a 0.35-second speed-based translation/rotation margin (minimum 0.15 metres and 12 degrees), and recentObservation for two seconds after demand. Tracking jumps or stale motion samples conservatively include geometry until fresh samples resume. Scoped one-off capture leases do not gain persistent demand. These are conservative loading hints, not proof of future visibility or a guaranteed loading deadline. Retained spatial envelopes also contribute dormant observation demand, without loading; unknown dormant geometry is conservatively included for owned views. Lighting retains effective local lamps whose conservative range envelope intersects an owned view, plus potential shadow casters overlapping hard-shadow lamp envelopes. This includes off-screen inputs, uses the same predictive/grace and capture loading paths, and does not inflate occupied geometry bounds. Disabled or zero-intensity lamps create no lighting demand. Unknown imported shadow geometry is retained until prepared; captures wait or fail rather than return incomplete lighting. Spot cones and animated recipe attachments use conservative enclosing envelopes. These are dependency hints, not proof of rendered shadows or reflections. Reading does not rebuild navigation or change saved state. Sleeping physics still needs its collision environment. Unavailable includes model geometry that is loading or failed. Saved structure arrangements alone do not connect objects. This is a passive transient diagnostic, not a saved revision or a request to unload. unloadingSupported reports whether the workspace enables automatic retirement. retirementState distinguishes disabled, waiting for reliable viewing, retained by dependencies, ready, preparing, dormant and failed; retirementIssue explains a failed attempt within the shared 128-character text bound. Idle connected areas can retire only with fresh reliable viewer tracking, after predictive/recent-view grace and every existing ownership, sound, animation, lighting, navigation, editing and collision guard releases them. One preparation runs at a time and is cancelled when viewing or inputs change. Failed preparation leaves native objects intact and does not retry every frame; changed inputs or renewed demand allow a later attempt. Viewing a dormant area or invoking an action restores it through the existing loading path. Running physics retains each active dynamic actor and its local collision, ground, water and physical-connection dependencies, including sleeping and pending bodies. Unknown actor bounds conservatively retain the environment; unrelated static areas may retire. Explicit Start prepares resident free dynamic actors and their local dependencies; unused dormant content stays unloaded, and resident imported-geometry failures with accepted collision bounds stop dependent actors locally. Unknown bounds or placement retain the global stop; repairing geometry does not silently resume failed motion. This does not expand the 64-object or spatial limits, promise offscreen simulation or establish physical loading performance. Missing objects are never treated as deleted by this report.

facts.label: Creation area
facts.description: Saved region membership for one creation. Empty regionId means the home region. The book and Maestro are world-owned. A membership edit neither moves nor unloads the object.

facts.label: Accepted ground near a point
facts.description: Inspect accepted authored terrain in this world and region. Input position and output position are authored coordinates in metres; normal uses authored axes. radius is the supported horizontal footprint in metres. The query samples the highest accepted surface within half a metre above/below the point, then eight footprint edges, using the same 25-degree slope and 10-centimetre step policy as walking. Scanned physical surfaces, ordinary props, held/dynamic ground and sculpt previews are not authored ground. availability is ready only when no potentially relevant saved ground is missing; pending means its native activation/loading is queued or running, and unavailable means at least one dependency is inactive, dormant or failed. dependencyCount counts all relevant incomplete objects; dependencies shows the first four stable object IDs in order, not the entire set; boundsKnown=false conservatively includes unknown extents. Known distant ground is excluded using a conservative envelope of all support rays. Incomplete availability forces found=false even if a lower resident surface exists. With ready and found=false, no resident surface satisfies the query policy. found=false means position/normal are unavailable placeholders. This reads collision geometry, not a NavMesh approximation. This passive read does not activate dependencies, test body/head clearance, reserve a route, move the viewer, start physics or change terrain. Read world.viewpoint and invoke world.viewpoint.set for an explicit relocation; clearance and current ground are rechecked at execution. Current worlds have one region and 25-metre coordinate bounds.

facts.label: Saved scanned ink anchor
facts.description: Current scan stateId (empty when unavailable), exact saved Meta identities and plane-local placement, layer size, current object revision and live availability. Missing/wrong-room/untracked anchors hide ink without deleting it. visible means the view is attached, not proof of headset rendering, physical alignment, no occlusion or intact real walls. Only explicit rebind changes saved identities. Ordinary drawings are unavailable for this fact; use object.surfaces for their ink.

facts.label: Loaded scanned-room layout
facts.description: On-demand bounded Meta scan layout in current room coordinates. available=false means counts are placeholders, not an empty physical room. Requires a loaded tracked MR room with colliders, no setup/workspace hold and an unscaled room frame. Read stateId before room.scan.surfaces or room.scan.surface. Identity changes with observed geometry, room frame or setup; snapshots are cached only within one Unity frame. At most 128 surfaces from 256 anchors; larger or malformed scans are unavailable, never silently truncated. omitted counts anchors without plane/volume bounds (including mesh-only geometry). Bounds are not full polygons, openings, current obstacles, free space, physical alignment or persistence guarantees. Reads never scan, request permission, start physics or save. Detailed geometry is queried explicitly, not added to background room observations.

facts.label: Scanned surface identities
facts.description: Four stable Meta anchor IDs and semantic labels per page, sorted by ID. Use the exact stateId from room.scan; changed/unavailable layouts refuse reads. offset=count returns an empty typed list; beyond count refuses. plane and volume describe available bounds, not proof that a surface is safe, visible or current. No raw mesh or camera image.

facts.label: Scanned surface pose and bounds
facts.description: Read one exact anchor using current stateId and ID from room.scan.surfaces. pose is room-local position and quaternion. Plane/volume center and size are anchor-local metres; transform by pose to use room coordinates. Meta planes lie in XY at z=0 and face local +Z, unlike drawing patches' -Z. Absent bounds have present=false and zero placeholders. Rectangles/boxes are bounds only: no polygon, cutouts, global mesh or moving obstacle detection. A new scan may replace UUIDs; never silently attach saved content to a similar-looking surface. No placement, drawing attachment or save occurs.

facts.label: Room physics state
facts.description: Current native simulation state and exact stateId for physics.simulation.set. canStart describes room collision and lifecycle admission to enable simulation; it does not require ground to be loaded. An explicit Start must still prepare the required dependencies of resident free dynamic actors. It does not activate every saved object. It is not permission to act, alignment approval or complete resource admission. running is explicit world enablement; running=true with ready=false means waiting for accepted ground. ready reports whether any currently selected environment has accepted ground and the authored region has no unresolved imported-collision bounds or placement. Native readiness changes alone do not change enabled intent. Known unavailable geometry stops dependent actors through local input checks, so room readiness does not guarantee every actor can move. Read object.physics.inputs for individual physics readiness and physics.environment for separate scan/virtual observations; neither room fact guarantees a clear navigation path. Running does not mean every actor has ground or that held/animated/fixed objects simulate. This read never starts, pauses or saves anything.

facts.label: Object physics inputs
facts.description: Read current native gravity/obstacle/water input ownership for a loaded solid/bouncy object and its connected physics group. Physical links share preparation and solver readiness; area membership alone does not create a physics group. Fixed, held, carried, paused and unavailable owners report inactive. A free member waiting for its ground, another member or a joint reports unavailable or pending. In an already running world, an owned free body may acquire dormant local ground while remaining stopped; it never borrows the scan when its policy requires virtual ground. Preparation does not admit gravity, impulses or settlement: current ground columns, complete local inputs and connected joints must all be ready. pending means bounded native preparation. After fixing unavailable inputs, pause and then start physics to retry. ready also rechecks current local geometry; it is not a clear path, completed throw or regional-streaming guarantee. dependencyCount counts the current required input identities; dependencies lists only the first four stable IDs. momentumHeld is transient velocity retained only during uninterrupted preparation: Pause, grab, animation, teleport, source edits and workspace retirement discard it. interrupted means a completed native step reached unavailable geometry or left its selected ground boundary. Unavailable geometry holds its free dynamic contact/constraint group while exact inputs prepare. A ground-boundary exit restores that group's last accepted poses and holds it; independent bodies keep running. Neither interruption replays old velocity. Grab, animation or teleport cancels the changed actor and its current physical connection group; merely touching another interrupted body does not grant control of it or resume it. Continuing native guard contacts are rechecked without requiring a fresh collision-enter callback. When preparation finishes, pause then start physics, or grab the object, to resume from rest. This is an explicit interruption, not a successful throw or authored contact. Reads never acquire native objects, start physics, save or change velocity. Retirement keeps each active dynamic actor and its local collision, ground, water and physical-connection dependencies, including sleeping and pending bodies. Unused unrelated areas may retire. Explicit Start prepares resident free dynamic actors and their local dependencies; unused dormant content stays unloaded, and unavailable resident imports with accepted collision bounds stop dependent actors locally. Unknown bounds or placement retain the conservative global stop. Repair requires a fresh physics owner; it never restores failed motion.

facts.label: Held object contact inputs
facts.description: Read the latest native contact-input ownership without loading, moving, saving or starting physics. pending means bounded preparation; unavailable must not be treated as clear space. Accepted dependency edits may be rechecked by the active owner; failed or cancelled loading requires a fresh action or tracking/grab owner after fixing its reason. ready rechecks required local geometry, not a clear path or regional-streaming guarantee. Dependencies report the full count and first four stable identities. The production whole-world physics gate remains. This fact covers an active physical controller/hand grab of a creation; unheld, paused or animation-owned items are inactive. A waiting grab holds its current pose and needs fresh throw samples before release. Scripted attachments use their separate existing ownership.

facts.label: Carried object contact inputs
facts.description: Read the latest native contact-input ownership without loading, moving, saving or starting physics. pending means bounded preparation; unavailable must not be treated as clear space. Accepted dependency edits may be rechecked by the active owner; failed or cancelled loading requires a fresh action or tracking/grab owner after fixing its reason. ready rechecks required local geometry, not a clear path or regional-streaming guarantee. Dependencies report the full count and first four stable identities. The production whole-world physics gate remains. Covers object.hold, fitted animation props and physical catches. Waiting keeps the actual prop in place and discards old throw history; fitted full-body playback shares the wait. This passive read does not follow an anchor, advance playback or prove the release path is clear. A released or retired attachment is inactive; inspect its receipt for the outcome.

facts.label: Recorded playback inputs
facts.description: Read the latest native contact-input ownership without loading, moving, saving or starting physics. pending means bounded preparation; unavailable must not be treated as clear space. Accepted dependency edits may be rechecked by the active owner; failed or cancelled loading requires a fresh action or tracking/grab owner after fixing its reason. ready rechecks required local geometry, not a clear path or regional-streaming guarantee. Dependencies report the full count and first four stable identities. The production whole-world physics gate remains. Covers recorded animation programs, recorded throws and manual recorded preview. Preparing pauses playback without replaying missed time. Inputs cover the complete bounded recorded root path, including intermediate keys, rotations and scale; they do not prove deforming limbs, solid path clearance or imported clip travel. Reading this fact does not start playback or acquire geometry.

facts.label: Authored avatar inputs
facts.description: Read the latest native contact-input ownership without loading, moving, saving or starting physics. pending means bounded preparation; unavailable must not be treated as clear space. Accepted dependency edits may be rechecked by the active owner; failed or cancelled loading requires a fresh action or tracking/grab owner after fixing its reason. ready rechecks required local geometry, not a clear path or regional-streaming guarantee. Dependencies report the full count and first four stable identities. The production whole-world physics gate remains. Covers Maestro's explicit authored travel from embedded clips and exact library motions. Pending native preparation preserves the last accepted full imported pose and pauses the same cumulative playback clock as fitted props. After readiness, existing ground, user-distance, body and water checks still decide movement. Movement checks every crossed source key, cubic component turning point and bounded 120 Hz body substep before committing a pose. Oversized intervals fail without partial movement. This is not continuous-curve or deforming-limb collision proof.

facts.label: Hand or controller contact inputs
facts.description: Read the latest native contact-input ownership without loading, moving, saving or starting physics. pending means bounded preparation; unavailable must not be treated as clear space. Accepted dependency edits may be rechecked by the active owner; failed or cancelled loading requires a fresh action or tracking/grab owner after fixing its reason. ready rechecks required local geometry, not a clear path or regional-streaming guarantee. Dependencies report the full count and first four stable identities. The production whole-world physics gate remains. Select the left or right tracked source. Tracking jumps and recovery inside an object keep the contact volume disabled until a fresh clear pose; they cannot replay a missed push. The visible hand/controller continues tracking.

facts.label: Walking action status
facts.description: Passive state of the current shared object.navigate or object.follow owner, including planning, moving, keepingDistance, arrived, blocked or failed. position is the native root in authored room metres; distance is accepted travel in this operation. Inactive means no shared walking owner (not proof that every other kind of motion has stopped). Legacy Maestro controls and animation use their existing facts. Missing native objects are unavailable. Reading does not load, move, start physics or retry an action.

facts.label: Maestro attention
facts.description: Passive latest head-gaze sample from the shared native layer, including legacy Look/Follow controls. point is in authored room metres. active means a gaze owner exists; applied requires a rendered gaze sample with reduced motion off. limited means the requested direction exceeds the head's yaw/pitch bounds. These angles are applied offsets, not eye-contact, occlusion or perceptual quality evidence. An inactive owner reports neutral fields. Reading never starts attention or loads a target.

facts.label: Physics environment
facts.description: Read the separate physical scan, authored ground and default-scope simulation readiness. ready additionally requires an active authored region with no unresolved imported-collision bounds or placement. Known unavailable geometry stops dependent actors through local input checks; room readiness does not guarantee every actor can move. scanReady and authoredReady remain separate raw ground observations. Individual profile admission is reported by object.environment; physics.simulation reports whether any accepted environment can run. This does not verify physical alignment or a clear route, start physics, load a scan or change its collision/visual/acoustic geometry. Physical placement continues to use scanReady even when authored ground is ready. No side effects.

facts.label: Object environment
facts.description: Saved profile binding and effective real-room participation. Empty profileId inherits the global switch. ready checks this actor's environment; inside checks its current centre against that environment's bounds. admitted means environment admission and running physics, not that this body's geometry, ownership or dynamic mode permits motion. Does not test a complete walking route or overlap.

facts.label: Environment profile
facts.description: Read the exact saved profile revision and all currently bound object IDs. Names are display metadata. Shared changes require every listed member as an explicit claim. Missing profiles are unavailable; never substitute by name.

facts.label: Environment profiles
facts.description: Read three reusable environment profiles at a time, ordered by stable ID. Start offset 0 and advance by pageSize until total. Definition pages do not claim targets or change the room.

facts.label: Appearances
facts.description: Reusable saved appearances ordered by stable ID. Three entries per page; advance offset by pageSize until total. Names are display text.

facts.label: Appearance definition
facts.description: Read the full supported saved style and current revision. Combine the source and surface fields into style for appearance.save. The name is available from appearance.library. Members are separately paged through appearance.members to fit bounded program values.

facts.label: Appearance members
facts.description: Sixteen exact object IDs per page, including dormant bindings; start offset 0. Before saving a shared change read all pages at the same definition revision. Save checks current complete membership and ownership again.

facts.label: Object appearances
facts.description: Two saved bindings per page, including dormant bindings and explicit local tint overrides. A specific part/material wins over root; root tint is not applied a second time. State describes binding availability, not physical interaction or visibility through other objects.

facts.label: Appearance targets
facts.description: Three stable root/part/import-material addresses per page, in that order. Source material indexes come from the loaded asset, not renderer order. Only state=active can receive a new binding. Pending/unavailable models require a later observation.

facts.label: Visual layer
facts.description: Saved opacity and physical-depth participation. Read all visibility.members pages at this revision before editing. Does not report effective device depth or camera sharing.

facts.label: Visual layers
